headline: China Crude Oil Imports From Persian Gulf Jump 42.4% in October
summary: China imported 19.7 million tons of crude oil from Persian Gulf producers excluding Iran in October, representing a 42.4% increase from September.
why: China is the world's largest crude oil importer, making its buying patterns a key driver of international oil prices and global shipping demand.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Increased crude oil buying from China directly boosts global oil market demand.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: China's crude imports from the Persian Gulf surged 42.4% month-on-month in October, signaling strong physical demand.
